device.soc: ALi M3606 (M3602 family with dual-CPU MIPS32 + SEE co-processor)

image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 (DVBS2---0.2.0), encrypted maincode container 0x020000 (LZMA maincode + SEE) -- 4 MB flash

simulator.note: Boots as M3602 with chip ID 0x3603: decrypts and unpacks maincode and SEE, prints 'model = 2:500HD', 'Soft Version = 14293' and 'MC: APP  init ok'.

desc: The V1.09.14293 patch firmware for the AB CryptoBox 500HD satellite receiver powered by the ALi M3606 SoC.
Uses the standard ALi dual-core architecture with front panel driven via GPIO 43/44/45.
